name: Lap Pool with Full-width Steps
headline: A long pool with an easy way in.
tagline: A rectangular lap pool with wide steps across the shallow end and a grey gelcoat finish. Shown filled, before the deck goes on.

images.alt: Long rectangular fiberglass pool with grey gelcoat, filled with clear water, with wide steps across the near end and a flat coping flange, set into bare ground before decking.
images.caption: Filled and ready for decking

priceNote: Shell only. Delivery and installation quoted per site.

features.title: Full-width entry steps
features.body: Wide steps across the shallow end make getting in easy for kids and older swimmers.

features.title: Long lap length
features.body: A straight, uninterrupted run of water for swimming laps.

features.title: Grey gelcoat
features.body: A grey interior gives the water a natural, lagoon-like color.

features.title: Wide coping flange
features.body: A broad flat edge all around for a clean finish under the deck.

specs.label: Entry
specs.value: Full-width steps at the shallow end
